scope: Finite exact replay supporting the separately written all-parameter proofs; no SFC de-amplification claim.
algorithm: Legendre valuation and recursive factorial-unit products modulo prime powers; constructed large factorials are never formed.

two_column_full_determinant_obstruction.qualification: Unamplified base columns coincide; this is not an SFC counterexample.

distinct_support_prefix_obstruction.qualification: Only the prefix of length two is poorly conditioned; the support-size three window has a unit third moment at both places above seven.

balanced_limit_invariant.scope: Rules out balanced coefficientwise limits under diagonal coefficient rescaling and degreewise scalar normalization; does not address arbitrary coefficient mixing.
